rule.formal_output_pattern:
ABSTRACT allocation schema, not executable GUMBO:
Trace(r) = <EnglishID, owner C, guard g, effect q, interfacePath, state/time map, implementation, proof, tests, gaps>.
For each owned requirement r: Env_C(I_k) AND Inv_C(S_k) AND g_r(I_k,S_k,t_k) => q_r(O_k,S_{k+1}); represent g_r => q_r as a compute-case obligation, not a global input restriction.
Initialize_C => all output DataPorts initialized AND required initial state/output relations; initialize reads no input ports.
For each connection P.out -> C.in: Guarantee_P AND Transport(path,schedule,startup) => Assumption_C at the consumer sample. An unresolved implication remains an open system obligation.
History relations: lastCmd at dispatch k equals the preceding published command; lastMonitorMode equals the preceding mode; establish initialization and updates explicitly.
Alarm in NORMAL: (T<L OR T>U) => cmd=On; ((L<=T AND T<L+0.5degF) OR (U-0.5degF<T AND T<=U)) => cmd=oldCmd; (L+0.5degF<=T AND T<=U-0.5degF) => cmd=Off.
Failure-range obligation: interface_failure => rangeValue unconstrained by the copying requirement AND consumers do not rely on that range; discharge using actual sampling and mode propagation.
Timed obligations remain separate from dispatch-local predicates: required status response delay <0.5s; required alarm response delay <5s; encode the English INIT-duration >1.0s timeout transition after resolving transition priority.
Composition refinement obligation: environment assumptions AND component contracts AND connection/schedule semantics => prepared system requirements. Every encoding must preserve physical meaning and all source interfaces.
misleading_near_matches: Assume both alarm inputs are valid, although the interface manager must detect invalid inputs.
The ports connect, therefore all consumer assumptions and latency requirements are satisfied.
A generated GUMBOX check passes, therefore the original English requirement is complete.
Unspecified alarm ranges may be used while failure propagation is pending.
Replace half-degree hysteresis with one integer unit because the observed model does so.

The alarm model uses 1 [s32] where English uses 0.5 degrees; concrete data definitions are absent, so scaling is unresolved. Only some output initial values are constrained. Proposed obligations: complete these representations and trace paths without weakening English. The 1000 ms interface period does not establish the required sub-0.5-second status response and presents an apparent timing conflict requiring schedule analysis or repair. Range validity flags do not establish numeric range ordering or freshness. The interface-to-mode-to-interface feedback and separate alarm path require a startup and sampling argument so a NORMAL alarm computation cannot improperly consume unspecified ranges.
